21:1: Iqeṛb ed i medden uqeṭṭi nnsen, u nitni stehzan, ur d rzin.
21:2: Ur ten d iţţas usmekti amaynut, sɣuṛ Mass nnsen, mebla ma ţţuraren, mara s sslen.
21:3: Ur d rzin wulawen nnsen. Pţemcawaṛen wid idensen, s tuffra: "d acu t wagi, siwa amdan am kunwi? Day a ţḍefṛem ssḥur, kunwi teţwalim"?
21:4: Inna: "Mass iw Iẓṛa timenna deg igenni, di tmurt. Neţţa Issel, Issen".
21:5: Maca, nnan: "d taffa n tirga. Xaṭi! Isnulfa t id. Xaṭi! Neţţa d amedyaz. Aha san, ad aɣ d iawi assekni, akken id iţţuceggaɛ i imezwura"!
21:6: Ur tumin, uqbel nnsen, yal temdint Nesqucc, day ad amnen nitni?
21:7: Ur d Nuzen, uqbel ik, siwa irgazen, iwumi Nweḥḥa. Steqsit imawlan usmekti, ma ur teẓṛim.
21:8: Ur ten Nerri d tifekkiwin ur nteţţ lqut. Ur wekkṛen.
21:9: Sinna, Neṭṭef deg wayen i sen Nɛahed, u Nsellek iten akked wid i ɣ ihwan. Nenɣa imcumen.
21:10: Ih, Nessers awen ed Tazmamt, degs asmekti nnwen. Day ur tefhimem ara?
21:11: Acḥal n temdinin idensen ay Neṛẓa! Nexleq, deffir sent, agdud nniḍen.
21:12: Mi ḥussen i lwaɛṛan nneɣ, atnan la regwlen, segs.
21:13: Ur regwlet ara, uɣalet ar wayen is testasrem, ar ixxamen nnwen. Amar fellawen asteqsi.
21:14: Nnan: "a yamxix nneɣ, nella, s tideţ, d imednas"!
21:15: Ur tfukk tiɣṛi yagi nnsen, armi ten Nerra d aqecqac urhif.
21:16: Ur Nexliq ara, i wurar nneɣ, igenni, tamurt, akked wayen illan garasen.
21:17: Lemmer day Nebɣi lhawiyya, yili Nebbwi ţ id, s ɣuṛneɣ, maday Naɛna.
21:18: Xaṭi! Nekkat tikerkas s tideţ. Tneqq itent. Neqḍent. A tawaɣit nnwen, ilmend n wayen d teggarem!
21:19: IneS kra illan di tmurt akked igenwan. Wid illan ɣuṛeS, ur smeɣwṛen ara iman nnsen, ɣef uɛabed iS. Ur ɛaggun.
21:21: Neɣ ddmen d, si tmurt, iṛebbiten id iţţaran ar ddunit?
21:22: Lemmer llin degsen iṛebbiten, war Ṛebbi, war ccekk, ad fesden. Gedha s Ṛebbi, Mass n usgeld, seg wayen id ggaren!
21:23: Ur fellaS asteqsi ɣef wayen Ixeddem. Nitni, fellasen asteqsi.
21:24: Neɣ day ddmen iṛebbiten, war Neţţa? Ini: "Awit ed atebbet nnwen". Ayagi d asmekti i wid illan yidi, d asmekti i wid illan, uqbel i. Maca, tegwti segsen, ur ssinen tideţ. Dɣa zzin akin.
21:25: Ur d Nuzen amazan, uqbel ik, siwa ma Nweḥḥa yas ar: "ur illi ṛebbi siwa Nek, ihi ɛabdet iyI".
21:26: Nnan: "Isɛa Uḥnin aqcic". Gedha s yiS! Xaṭi! D imdanen imaɛzuzen.
21:27: Ur S d zeggwiren deg wawal, xedmen s lameṛ iS.
21:28: Iẓṛa i illan zdat sen, akked wayen illan deffir sen. Ur ččafɛan, siwa ɣef win Iṛuḍa. U nitni, si lxuf iS, ţḥadaren.
21:29: Win, segsen, id innan: "nek d ṛebbi, war Neţţa", a t Nqeṭṭi s Loahennama. Akka ay Neţqeṭṭi imednas.
21:30: Neɣ wid ijehlen ur walan ara tamurt akked igenwan llan mlalen? Nessemfaṛaq iten, Nga s waman kra n wayen idren. Ihi, day ur ţţamnen ara?
21:31: Nerra di tmurt idurar, iwakken ur teţḥerrik ara yissen. Nerra, degsen, tiza d iberdan, amar ad ţwanhun.
21:32: Nerra igenni d ssqef innestaṛen, u nitni ooan issekniyen nneɣ.
21:33: D Neţţa i Ixelqen iḍ akked wass, iṭij akked waggur, yal wa iteddu deg ubrid is.
21:34: Ur Nefka ara, uqbel ik, tameddurt n lebda i umdan. Day kečč a ţţemmteḍ, nitni ad wekkṛen?
21:35: Yal amdan ad ijeṛṛeb tameţţant. Neţjeṛṛib ikwen s cceṛṛ, akked lxiṛ. D ahewwel. ɣuṛneɣ tuɣalin nnwen.
21:36: Mara k id walin wid ijehlen, ţmmaɛliken kan fellak: "d wagi id ikkaten deg iṛebbiten nnwen"? Nitni nekṛen asmekti n Uḥnin.
21:37: Iţwaxleq umdan si leḥmeq. Ad awen d Ssenɛateɣ issekniyen iW, ihi, ur iyI ɣeṣbet.
21:39: Wid ijehlen, a lemmer ad ẓṛen tagwniţ ideg ur d tekksen udmawen nnsen, neɣ iɛrar nnsen, si tmes! Nitni ur ţwasellken.
21:40: Xaṭi! A ten id ias, deqzalla, a ten iwwet baɣa, ur zmiren a t rren, neɣ ad gganin.
21:41: Niɣ ttahan ɣef imazanen, uqbel ik! Ayen iɣef mmaɛlken, izzi d ɣef wid, segsen, i ittahan.
21:42: Ini: "anwa ara kwen ifukken, iḍ akked wass, seg Uḥnin"? Maca, ooan asmekti n Mass nnsen.
21:43: Neɣ sɛan iṛebbiten ara ten ifukken, war Nekwni? Ur zmiren ad sellken iman nnsen, ur sɛin imɛiwnen mgal aɣ.
21:44: Xaṭi! Nestaser i wigi akked imezwura nnsen, ar tewser nnsen. Day ur walan ara, Neţţas ed ar tmurt, Nessenqas si leryaf is? Day d Nitni ara irebḥen?
21:45: Ini: "la kwen nedṛeɣ kan, s uweḥḥi". Ur sellen iɛẓẓugen i unabi ma ţţunedṛen.
21:46: Ma iḥuza ten uṣuḍu uɛaqeb n Mass ik, war ccekk, a d inin: "a ssexḍ nneɣ! Ih, nella d imednas".
21:47: A n Nessers lmizanat iṣewben, ass n tnekra. Ur iţwadnes umdan s wacemma. Xas d aɛqqa ucceryad, a t id Nawi. Nesteqnaɛ yisneɣ i uqeṭṭi.
21:48: Niɣ Nefka i Musa akked Haṛun, afraz, akked tafat d usmekti, i wid iţḥezziben.
21:49: Wid iţţagwaden Mass nnsen, ur T walan, u ţḥaraben ɣef yimir.
21:50: Wagi d asmekti iṛqan, id Nessader. Day a t tagwim kunwi?
21:51: Niɣ Nefka, zik, nnhaya s i Ibṛahim? Nella Nessen it.
21:52: Mi inna i baba s akked ugdud is: "d acu tent tɛancurin agi, i la teţkabarem"?
21:53: Nnan d: "Nufa d imezwura nneɣ la tent ɛabden".
21:54: Inna: "ihi, tellam, kunwi akked imezwura nnwen, di ttelfan n ṣṣeḥ".
21:55: Nnan: "tusiḍ aɣ d, s tideţ, neɣ kečč seg wid iţţuraren"?
21:56: Inna: "xaṭi. Mass nnwen d Mass n tmurt akked igenwan, id Ixleq. Nek, seg inagan n waya.
21:57: S Ṛebbi, ard ad andiɣ i tɛancuṛin nnwen, mara teṭṭixxṛem".
21:58: Isseftutes itent, siwa tameqwṛant degsent, amar a d uɣalen ɣuṛes.
21:59: Nnan: "anwa i igan akka i iṛebbiten nneɣ? Neţţa, war ccekk, d amednus".
21:60: Nnan: "nesla i ilemẓi, itent id iudren, isem is Ibṛahim".
21:61: Nnan: "awit eţ id, zdat wallen n medden, amar ad ilin d inagan".
21:62: Nnan: "day d kečč i igan akka, i iṛebbiten nneɣ, a Ibṛahim"?
21:63: Inna: "xaṭi, i igan akka, d ameqwṛan nnsen agi. Steqsit ţen, ma ţmeslayen".
21:64: Endekwalen d. Nnan: "ih, d kunwi ay d imednas".
21:65: Sinna, bran i iqweṛṛa nnsen: "niɣ wigi, teẓṛiḍ, ur ţmeslayen ara"!
21:66: Inna: "day tɛabdem, war Ṛebbi, ayen ur kwen inefɛan, ur kwen iṭṭuṛṛun, s wacemma?
21:67: Tfuh i kunwi, akked wayen tɛabdem, war Ṛebbi! Day ur tefhimem ara"?
21:68: Nnan: "sseṛɣet eţ, u sellket iṛebbiten nnwen, ma tɛazmem".
21:69: Nenna: "a times, ili d tasmuḍi u d talwit, i Ibṛahim".
21:70: Undin as ţ. Nerra ten d imexsuṛen maḍi.
21:71: Nsellek it, akked Luṭ, ar tmurt i Neṛqa i imaḍalen.
21:72: Nefka yas Isḥaq, Nerna yas Yaɛqub. I sin, Nerra ten d wid imaɛnen.
21:73: Nerra ten d imḍebbṛen, nehhun s lameṛ nneɣ. Nweḥḥa yasen igiten ilhan, taẓallit, azekki. Llan d wid i ɣ iɛabden.
21:74: I Lut, Nefka ṣṣwab, tamusni. Nsellek it si temdint i illan txeddem tucmitin. Llan, s tideţ, d agdud n dir, d laɛṛuṛ.
21:75: Nesskecm it deg uḥunu nneɣ. Neţţa, ih, seg wid imaɛnen.
21:76: I Nuḥ, zik, mi inɛaṛ. Njaweb as ed. Nsellek it, neţţa akked twacult is, si lefqaɛ abarar.
21:77: Neneḥḥel it mgal agdud i iskaddben issekniyen nneɣ. Llan, s tideţ, d agdud n dir. Neɣḍes iten meṛṛa.
21:78: I Dawed akked Sliman, mi ḥudden ɣef yiger, ideg ksant wulli n medden. Nella d Inagan uḥuddu nnsen.
21:79: Nessfehm as ţ i Sliman. I sin, Nefka ṣṣwab, tamusni. Nḥeţţem i idurar akked igḍaḍ ad sbuccɛen Dawed. D ayen Newqem.
21:80: Nessḥefḍ as, ad awen iṣnaɛ iceṭṭiḍen, ara iḥarben fellawen si tiytiwin. Day a ţţesnemmrem?
21:81: I Sliman, aḍu n tarikt, iţṣuḍu s lameṛ is, ɣer tmurt i Neṛqa. Nezga Nẓeṛ yal cci.
21:82: Ger ccwaṭen, wa iɣeḍḍes as, wa iqubel cceɣl nniḍen. Nella d imḥaraben nnsen.
21:83: I Yub, mi inuj ɣeṛ Mass is: "nek ţwaɣeɣ. Kečč, Tifeḍ akw wid iţḥunun".
21:84: Njaweb as ed. Nekkes as it iḍuṛṛen; Nerra yas d tawacult is, akw, yides, tin i ţ icban. D aḥunu sɣuṛneɣ, d asmekti i iɛabaden.
21:85: Ismaɛil, Idris, Dulkifl, akken ma llan, d iṣebṛiyen.
21:86: Nesskecm iten deg uḥunu nneɣ. Nitni, s tideţ, seg wid imaɛnen.
21:87: I Dannun, mi iṛuḥ s wurrif. Iɣil ur Nesɛi ara adabu fellas. Inɛaṛ, di tellis: "ur illi ṛebbi siwa Kečč. Gedha s yiseK! Nek lliɣ si imednas".
21:88: Njaweb as ed. Nɛateq it si ẓẓmik. Akka ay Nɛateq lmumnin.
21:89: I Zakaria, mi inuj ɣuṛ Mass is: "a Mass iw! Ur iyi Iţţaooa ara d amengur. Kečč, Tifeḍ akw iweṛṛaten".
21:90: Njaweb as ed. Nefka yas Yaḥia, Nesseḥla yas tameṭṭut is. Nitni, s tideţ, izga izwar lxiṛ nnsen. Pnujun ɣuṛneɣ, s tugwdi d usirem. Unzen aɣ.
21:91: Ar tin i iqqimen zeddiget, Nṣuḍ si ṛṛuḥ nneɣ. Nerra ţ, neţţat akked mmi s, d assekni i imaḍalen.
21:92: Lois agi nnwen, war ccek, d lois yiwen. Nek d Mass nnwen, ihi ɛabdet iyI.
21:93: Gezmen lameṛ nnsen garasen. ɣuṛneɣ, akw, ara d uɣalen.
21:94: Win ixeddmen ayen ilhan u irna iumen, ur iţṛuḥu laɛtab is. Ih, Nekwni Neţţaru fellas.
21:95: Iţwagdel asen a d uɣalen ɣeṛ temdint i Nesqucc,
21:96: alamma serrḥen d i Iaouo d Maouo. Nitni, si yal tiɣilt, a d azzlen.
21:97: Tqeṛb ed lemɛahda n tideţ. Atan iqquṛ yiẓṛi n wid ijehlen: "a tawaɣit nneɣ! Niɣ nella neɣfel ɣef waya. U, aɛer, nella d imednas.
21:98: Kunwi, s tideţ, akked wayen tɛabden, war Ṛebbi, d isɣaṛen n Loahennama. ɣures, kunwi, teţţeddum.
21:99: Lemmer llin widak d iṛebbiten, ur ţ keččmen. Akw, ad wekkṛen degs.
21:100: I nitni, degs, zzhir. Nitni, degs, ur sellen.
21:101: Ma d wid iwumi izwar ssaɛd, sɣuṛneɣ, widak, segs, ad baɛden.
21:102: Ur sellen i ṣṣut is. Ad wekkṛen deg wayen cihwant teṛwiḥin nnsen.
21:103: Ur ten iɣwebbel lweḥc abarar. A ten magrent lmalayek: "assa, d ass nnwen, i wen iţţuwaɛɛden".
21:104: Ass ideg ara Nesnefḍas igenni am tweṛqeţ n tira, akken Nebda axlaq amezwaru, ad as Nales. D lemɛahda fellaneɣ. Akka, ih, ara Nexdem.
21:105: Niɣ Nura deg Ihellilen, deffir usmekti: "ara iweṛten tamurt, d imdanen iW imaɛnen".
21:106: Deg wayagi, war ccekk, d asali i ugdud iɛabbaden.
21:107: Ur k id Nuzen, siwa d aḥunu i imaḍalen.
21:108: Ini: "iyi d iţţuweḥḥan, siwa: Ṛebbi nnwen d Ṛebbi Yiwen kan. Kunwi ma d imḍuɛen"?
21:109: Ma wexxṛen, ini: "ɛaggneɣ awen, akken ma tellam; ur ẓṛiɣ ma iqṛeb, neɣ ibɛad, ayen i wen iţţuwaɛɛden.
21:110: Neţţa, s tideţ, Issen awal d iffɣen, Issen ayen tessusmem.
21:111: Ur ẓṛiɣ ma, ayagi, ahat d ahewwel nnwen, u d zzhu n tallit kan.
21:112: Inna: "a Mass iw! Eḥkem s tideţ. Mass nneɣ, Aḥnin, i neţţer d Amɛiwen, mgal ayen teţţandim".
22:1: A yimdanen! Ḥezzbet i Mass nnwen, zzenzla n yimir, stideţ, d tadyant tabarart.
22:2: Ass ideg ara ţ twalim, yal timṛebbit a ţţeţţu win tessuṭṭuḍ, yal tadist a ţţexseṛ. A ţwaliḍ imdanen ssekṛen, ur sskiṛen. Maca, aɛaqeb n Ṛebbi iwɛaṛ.
22:3: Ger yimdanen, illa win iţnamaren ɣef Ṛebbi, war tamusni. Iteddu d yal cciṭan imcebbwel.
22:4: Iura fellas: "ar wagi, win i t irran d bab is, ara t itlef, s tideţ, u a t inheṛ ar uɛaqeb ujajiḥ".
22:5: A yimdanen! Ma di ccekk ay tellam f tnekra, ihi, Nekwni, s tideţ, Nxelq ikwen seg wakal, sinna, si tiqqit n lɣella, sinna, seg urgan, sinna, si tecriḥt, texleq ur texliq, iwakken ad awen Nbeggen. Neţţara, di tɛabbuḍin, ayen i ɣ ihwan, alamma d lajel iţwassnen. Sinna, Nessuffuɣ ikwen id d llufanat, sinna a ţţimɣuṛem. Segwen llan wid iţţemmten, u segwen win ara iawḍen d awessur, ard ur iţţisin acemma seg wayen issen. A ţwalid akal d aɣuṛaṛ. Ma Nesseɣli d ageffur fellas, ad ikker, ad icuff, a d ifk tayuga n yal ṣṣenf uziyn n leɣṛus.
22:6: Ayagi, acku Ṛebbi d Tideţ. D Neţţa id Issidiren lmeggtin. Neţţa Izmer i yal cci.
22:7: U imir a d ias, war ccekk fellas. U Ṛebbi a d Issker wid illan di tneṭlin.
22:8: Ger imdanen, illa win iţnamaren ɣef Ṛebbi, war tamusni, neɣ nnhaya, neɣ Tazmamt ifeten.
22:9: Icuff aqenduṛ, iwakken ad itlef seg ubrid n Ṛebbi. Fellas xezzu di ddunit. Deg wass n tnekra, a Nessuk fellas aɛaqeb n tmeṛɣiwt.
22:10: Ayagi, ɣef wayen id urwen ifassen ik. U Ṛebbi ur Idennis imdanen.
22:11: Ger yimdanen, win iɛabden Ṛebbi, ɣef rrif. Ma iusa t id lxiṛ, ad ithenni yis. Ma iusa t id uhewwel, ad iswexxeṛ udem is. Ṛuḥent as, ddunit, laxeṛt. Ayagi d lexsaṛa n ṣṣeḥ.
22:12: Iţnuju, war Ṛebbi, ar wayen ur t neṭṭuṛṛu, ur t neffaɛ. D wagi ay d ttelfan uɣmiq.
22:13: Iţnuju ar bu ḍḍeṛṛ izwaren abaɣuṛ ines. Ay d bab ucmit, ay d acrik ucmit.
22:14: Ṛebbi, s tideţ, ad Issekcem wid iumnen, i ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ar Loennet, ddaw as isaffen ţţazzalen. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Ixeddem ayen Ibɣa.
22:15: Win i oaɛlen ur t Iţsellik ara Ṛebbi, di ddunit, di laxeṛt, ad iɛalleq amrar s igenni, sinna, ad igzem nnefs is. Ad iẓeṛ ma tiḥḥeṛci s temḥa ayen i t irḥan.
22:16: Akka ay t id Nessader, d issekniyen iberrzen. U Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Inehhu win i S ihwan.
22:17: Ih, ass n tnekra, ad Iḥudd Ṛebbi ger wid iumnen, udayen, iṣabiyen, imasiḥiyen, u iɛabbaden n tmes, wid iţcaraken. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Iwala yal cci.
22:18: Ur twalaḍ ara knan i Ṛebbi i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt: iṭij, aggur, itran, idurar, ttjuṛ, lḥayawan, aṭas n yimdanen. Aɛaqeb d lewoeb ɣef aṭas. Win Isdull Ṛebbi, ur illi w ara t iɛuzzen. Ih, Ṛebbi Ixeddem ayen i S ihwan.
22:19: Atnan sin ixṣimen ţţemqellaɛn ɣef Mass nnsen. S tmes ay ţwafeṣlen iceṭṭiḍen n wid ijehlen. Ad mmiren, ɣef iqweṛṛa nnsen, waman iṛɣan
22:20: ara issefsin ayen illan deg iɛabbaḍ nnsen, akked igwelman.
22:22: Yal tikelt ara ssirmen a d ffɣen segs, seg wakken meḥnen, a ten rren ɣuṛes: "jeṛṛbet aɛaqeb n tmeṛɣiwt"!
22:23: Ṛebbi, s tideţ, ad Issekcem wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ar Loennet, ddaw as isaffen ţţazzalen. Degs ad qqnen imeqyasen n ddheb d lyaqut. Leḥrir deg iceṭṭiḍen nnsen.
22:24: Pwanhan s awal umɛin, ţwanhan s abrid Umaɛzuz.
22:25: Ih, i wid ijehlen i issefṛaɣen abrid n Ṛebbi, akked Loamaɛ n Lḥaṛam, i Nerra i imdanen, ama d amezdaɣ n din, ama d abeṛṛani; i win ibɣan degs tijehli, s ddens, a Nesɛaddi aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
22:26: Mi Nhegga i Ibṛahim, amkan n Uxxam: "ur iyI ţcarak acemma! Zizdeg axxam iW i wid idewwiṛen, wid ibedden, wid iṭṭinizen, iknan.
22:27: Enced medden ar lḥio. A d asen ɣuṛek ɣef uḍaṛ, neɣ ɣef yal amerkub ulṭif. A d asen si yal abrid ibaɛden.
22:28: Ad cehhden ɣef lɣit nnsen. A d smektin ism n Ṛebbi, deg ussan iţwassnen, ɣef ubhim n lmal i sen Ifka. Eččet segs, cceččet ameɣbun, aẓawali.
22:29: Sinna, ad ssirden, ad qenɛen asirem nnsen, ad dewwṛen i Uxxam aqdim".
22:30: Akka. Win iţţɛuzzun ayen Igdel Ṛebbi, ilha yas kteṛ, ar Mass is. Ḥellen awen lmal, siwa wid i wen mlan. Janbet lɛaṛ n tɛancuṛin, janbet awal n ẓẓuṛ;
22:31: am wid imalen ar tideţ ar Ṛebbi, ur aS ţcaraken. Win iţcaraken i Ṛebbi, amzun iɣli d seg igenni, u iccelqef it ufṛux, neɣ inheṛ it waḍu, s amekkan lqayen.
22:32: Akka. Win iţţɛuzzun isekkiren n Ṛebbi, ihi, d aḥezzeb n wulawen.
22:33: I kunwi degs abaɣuṛ ar lajel iţwassnen, sinna, ṭḥegga nnsen ar Uxxam aqdim.
22:34: I yal lois, Nefka asekkir, iwakken a d smektin ism n Ṛebbi, ɣef ubhim n lmal is iten Nɣat. Ṛebbi nnwen d Ṛebbi Yiwen. Ihi, anzet aS. Becceṛ itubiyen,
22:35: wid iwumi ţţergigin wulawen nnsen mara d mmektin Ṛebbi, wid iṣebbṛen i wayen iten iuɣen, wid iţẓallan u ţseddiqen seg wayen is iten Nɣat.
22:36: Lmal iqebbwan, Nerra yawen ten, seg isekkiren n Ṛebbi. Degsen lfayda i kunwi. Bedret fellasen isem n Ṛebbi, mara d rsen. Mi ɣlin ɣef ibeṛdiyen nnsen, eččet segsen, cceččet aɛṭṭaṛ, aẓawali. Akka ay d Nenub fellawen yissen, amar a ţţesnemmrem.
22:37: Ur iţţaweḍ ar Ṛebbi uksum nnsen, neɣ idamen nnsen, d awezɣi. Ara T iawḍen, d aḥezzeb nnwen. Am akka, Inub fellawen yissen, iwakken ad aS tgem ccan i Ṛebbi, ilmend n nnhaya nnwen sɣuṛeS. Becceṛ wid imaɛnen.
22:38: Ih, Ṛebbi Iţfukku wid iumnen. Ih, Ṛebbi ur Iḥemmel ara yal lxayen ajehli.
22:39: Tsriḥ i wid iţwawwḍen imi ţwadensen - Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Izmer a ten Isellek -,
22:40: wid id ssuffɣen seg ixxamen nnsen, war ssebba, imi kan qqaṛen: "Mass nneɣ d Ṛebbi". Lemmer ur Iswexxiṛ ara Ṛebbi imdanen, kra s kra, ara iţwahudden, war ccekk, d tiqwebtin, timezgida, lemṣellat, lowamaɛ ideg d smektayen, aṭas, ism n Ṛebbi. Ih, Ṛebbi Iţţaɛwan win iT iţţaɛwanen. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, d Uohid, d Uzmir.
22:41: Wid, ma Nessqɛad iten di tmurt, bedden i tẓallit, ţzekkin, ţţamṛen lewqama, gedlen tuccḍa. Ar Ṛebbi ara d gwrin lumuṛ.
22:42: Ma skaddben k, niɣ skaddben, uqbel nnsen, igduden n Nuḥ, Ɛad, akked Tamud,
22:43: agdud n Ibṛahim, akked ugdud n Luṭ,
22:44: At Madyan. Skaddben Musa. Fkiɣ lmudda i ijehliyen, sinna, Zziɣ d fellasen. A tuzzma W imiren!
22:45: Acḥal n temdinin ay Nesqucc imi densent. Haatent ţţint. Xlan lebyar, akked lebruo uohiden.
22:46: Day ur unagen ara di tmurt? Ad sɛun, ɣef waya, ulawen ad fehmen yissen, imeẓẓuɣen ara islen yissen. Maca, mačči d allen, d ulawen deg idmaren i idreɣlen.
22:47: Bɣan k a d tesqeṛbeḍ aɛaqeb. Ṛebbi ur Iţzeggil lemɛahda S, d awezɣi. Niɣ ass, ar Mass ik, am agim iseggwasen, s leḥsab nnwen.
22:48: Acḥal n temdinin iwumi Fkiɣ lmudda, u irna densent. Sinna, Zziɣ fellasent. ɣuṛI tuɣalin.
22:49: Ini: "a yimdanen! Nek, ɣuṛwen, d aneddaṛ kan iţbegginen".
22:50: I wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ssmaḥ akked ṛṛeẓq ukyis.
22:51: Wid iaɛnan asfunneg issekniyen nneɣ, widak d at ujajiḥ.
22:52: Ur d Nuzen, uqbel ik, amazan neɣ nnbi, mebla ma ikecm ed Cciṭan, deg wayen imenna, ma imenna. Itekkes Ṛebbi ayen d issekcam Cciṭan, sinna, Itebbit issekniyen iS. Ṛebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
22:53: Iwakken ad Irr aggway n Cciṭan d ahewwel, i at wulawen iblan akked at wulawen aquṛan. Ih, imednas atnan di tɣennant tuɣmiqt.
22:54: Iwakken ad ẓṛen wid iwumi teţţunefk tmusni, ar neţţa d tideţ, sɣuṛ Mass ik. Ad amnen yis. Ad as anzen wulawen nnsen. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Inehhu wid iumnen, s abrid uwqim.
22:55: Zgan wid ijehlen di ccekk fellas, ar ten id ias yimir, deqzalla, neɣ ibbweḍ iten id uɛaqeb n wass abarar.
22:56: Assen, tagelda i Ṛebbi. Ad Iḥudd garasen. Wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ad ilin di Loennet n ssuɛada.
22:57: I wid ijehlen, iskaddben issekniyen nneɣ, aɛaqeb isdullun.
22:58: Wid iunagen, deg ubrid n Ṛebbi, sinna, ţwanɣan neɣ mmuten, a ten Iɣit Ṛebbi, war ccekk, s ṛṛeẓq umɛin. Ih, Ṛebbi Yif akw imɣiten.
22:59: A ten Issekcem anekcum ara ṛadin. Ih, Ṛebbi d Amusnaw, Iḥellem.
22:60: Akka. Win iɛaqben akken iţţuɛaqeb, sinna, iţwadnes, war ccekk, a t Isellek Ṛebbi. Ih, Ṛebbi Iţqili, Iţsemmiḥ.
22:61: Akka, acku Ṛebbi Issekcam iḍ deg wass, Issekcam ass deg yiḍ. U Ṛebbi Issel, Iţwali.
22:62: Akka, acku Ṛebbi d tideţ, ma d ayen uɣuṛ ţnujun, war Neţţa, d tikerkas. Ih, Ṛebbi d Aɛlɛyan, d Ameqwṛan.
22:63: Day ur twalaḍ ara Ṛebbi Isseɣli d aman, seg igenni, dɣa izzegzew wakal? Ih, Ṛebbi d Laṭif, Iẓṛa.
22:64: IneS i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Ih, Ṛebbi, ar Neţţa d Asɛay d Amaɛzuz.
22:65: Ur twalaḍ ara Ṛebbi Inub ed fellawen s wayen illan di tmurt, akked lbabur iţţazalen di yill, s lameṛ iS. Iṭṭef igenni ur d iɣelli f tmurt, siwa ma Iunef as. Ih, Ṛebbi, war ccekk, Issuruf u Iţḥunu i imdanen.
22:66: D Neţţa ikwen Issadren, sinna, ara kwen Inɣen, sinna, ara kwen id Issadren. Amdan, s tideţ, d ajehli.
22:67: I yal lois, Nefka asekkir, teddun degs. Ulayɣeṛ i k ţnaɣen ɣef lameṛ. Nuj ar Mass ik; ih, aql ak, kečč, di nnhaya tuwqimt.
22:68: Ma numren k, ini: "Ṛebbi Yif akw akken Issen ayen txeddmem.
22:69: Ṛebbi ad Iḥudd garawen, ass n tnekra, ɣef wayen tellam temgarradem".
22:70: Day ur teẓṛiḍ ara Ṛebbi Issen i illan deg igenni akked tmurt? Ayagi, s tideţ, di Tezmamt. Ih, ayagi ishel i Ṛebbi.
22:71: La ɛabden, war Ṛebbi, ayen iwumi ur d Issers adabu, ayen ur ssinen. Imednas, ur illi wa ara ten isellken.
22:72: Ma mlan asen issekniyen nneɣ iberrzen, a ţɛaqleḍ asmmummi deg udmawen n wid ijehlen. Qṛib ad ẓeḍmen ɣef wid i sen iqqaṛen issekniyen nneɣ. Ini: "a kwen xebbṛeɣ af wayen iɣelben aya: times i Iɛahed Ṛebbi i wid ijehlen". A tuɣalin tucmiţ!
22:73: A yimdanen! Iţţunefk ed umedya, selt as d: ih, wid uɣuṛ teţnujum, war Ṛebbi, ur zmiren, d awezɣi, a d xelqen izi, xas mlalen ɣef waya. Ma illa wayen i sen iuker yizi, ur zmiren ad as t id kksen. D uṛhif umsuter, d uṛhif win issuter.
22:74: Ur qudṛen ara Ṛebbi, azal n lqedṛ iS. Ih, Ṛebbi d Uohid, d Uzmir.
22:75: Ṛebbi Iferren imazanen ger lmalayek, u ger imdanen. Ih, Ṛebbi Issel, Iţwali.
22:76: Issen i illan zdat sen, i illan deffir sen. Ar Ṛebbi ad uɣalen lumuṛ.
22:77: A wid iumnen! Ṭṭinzet u knut, ɛabdet Mass nnwen, xedmet lxiṛ, amar a ţrebḥem.
22:78: Jahdet ar Ṛebbi lḥeqq ujahed iS. Neţţa Ifren ikwen. Ur kwen Ihejjen ara di ddin, ddin ubabat wen Ibṛahim. Neţţa, i wen isemman, zik, imḍuɛen. Deg waya, ad yili Umazan d anagi nnwen, u a ţţilim d inagan n medden. Ihi, ẓẓallet, zekkit, teṭṭfem di Ṛebbi. Neţţa d Bab nnwen. D Bab amxallef, d Asellak amxallef.
